offering_description.value: Owns, operates and manages self-storage facilities that rent storage units to individuals and small businesses, mainly in the US with some properties in Canada. Revenue comes from unit rentals and ancillary fees, and the company also manages storage properties for third-party owners.

primary_products.value: storage units; packing and moving supplies

primary_services.value: self-storage rental; property management for third-party owners; tenant insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals storing household goods, vehicles and personal items; B2B: small businesses and commercial tenants renting storage space

end_markets.value: consumer storage; residential moving; small business storage

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: customers pay monthly rent for storage units; service fees: tenant insurance and administrative or ancillary fees; product sales: boxes, locks and moving supplies sold at facilities; commissions or management fees: fees for managing storage properties owned by third parties
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs self-storage buildings, takes in rent from storage tenants; service provider: manages storage facilities and tenant services for property owners and tenants

geography_served.value: North America: primarily US states such as Texas, Florida, California and Arizona, plus Canadian properties in Ontario

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned storage facilities where customers rent units; online: website and online rental reservations for storage units

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: property, zoning, consumer and securities rules, plus REIT tax requirements, no operating license needed

notes: Facility count, Canadian holdings and exact product mix may have changed; details are from general knowledge.
